Subject: Request: emergency credit for overnight throughput sweep

Hi Ben,

Quick note from the ops team — our infra lead is planning a 36–48 hour overnight throughput sweep (night-of Aug 5) to validate horizontal autoscaling and p95 latency under synthetic load. The current trial quota will run out mid-sweep unless we get a temporary uplift.

Estimated footprint: ~18M tokens over 36h, burst to 3.5k concurrent requests for short windows, average qps ~900. We need a one-time promotional uplift or sandbox top-up to avoid false negatives.

Can Redwood sponsor a short-term subsidy? We’re on a tight timeline; the sweep is critical to internal buy-in. Happy to share the load plan and expected metrics.

Thanks,
Alexandra Chen

- Tokens: 18,000,000 total (we should size for 20M to be safe)
